title: Release e2e checks must not discover the surrounding git repo
goal: The v0.18.0 cut aborted: the gate's scratch dir lives under target/ inside the susi worktree, so 'susi tasks' in a check found the real repo and listed its tasks instead of an empty queue (the integration test uses a plain temp dir, so it never saw this). Run each check with GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES set to the scratch root so git cannot discover a parent repo, and add a regression test that runs the checks with the scratch inside a git repo holding a task.
